name: Wit of the Stormy Sky
body:
School transmutation; Level: jester 9

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of combat, you gain a fly speed equal to your base speed (perfect maneuverability).
